activities.title: Butterfly and Birdwatching Walk at Woodlands Botanic Gardens
activities.location: Woodlands Botanic Garden, 134 Marsiling Rd, 730134, Singapore
activities.description:
Join our guides from the Butterfly & Insect Group and Bird Group to explore Woodlands Botanic Gardens. At least 15 resident butterflies have been recorded here including the Common Rose, Common Birdwing, Black-veined Tiger, Julia Longwing, Peacock Royal and Leopard Lacewing. In addition to butterflies, the many flowers and plants in this garden are also attractive to sunbirds, flowerpeckers and other garden birds like the Black-naped Oriole and Yellow-vented Bulbul. As this walk will take place during the migration season, sightings of migrant birds like the Brown Shrike or passing Oriental Honey Buzzard may be possible. This walk will start at 8 am. Details on the meeting point will be shared with confirmed participants. 

Maximum No. of Participants:25 pax 

Closing Date29 November 2026, Sunday 

Things to BringBring along a sun protection, water for hydration, rain gear, wear proper walking shoes and wear light appropriate clothing to prevent insect bites. 

EnquiriesFor any enquiries, please contact us at outreach@nss.org.sg 

Note:•⁠ ⁠Registration is on a first-come-first-serve basis.•⁠ ⁠Registration will close once the maximum number of participants is reached, or on closing date.•⁠ ⁠Only confirmed participants will be contacted by email, after the closing date, with details on the meeting time and place.

activities.title: Nature Walk at Pasir Ris Mangroves
activities.description:
Open to the Public 
Join our Nature Stewards volunteers on a leisurely walk through the Pasir Ris Mangrove and uncover the secrets of this habitat. Keep your eyes peeled for wildlife such as monitor lizards, Oriental Pied Hornbills, spitting cobras, tent spiders, mudskippers and much more. Along the way, learn about the important role mangroves play in supporting biodiversity and protecting our coastlines. 
Maximum No. of Participants:15 pax 
Closing Date29 November 2026, Sunday 
Things to BringBring along a  sun protection, water for hydration, rain gear, wear proper walking shoes and wear light appropriate clothing to prevent insect bites.

activities.title: Nature Walk at Windsor Nature Park
activities.location: Windsor Nature Park, 30 Venus Dr, Singapore 573858, Singapore
activities.description:
Open to the Public 

Join our Nature Stewards volunteers on a leisurely walk through Windsor Nature Park and explore the wonders of Singapore’s secondary forest. Keep your eyes peeled for wildlife such as long-tailed macaques, plantain squirrels, Sunda colugos, woodpeckers, and freshwater fishes. Along the way, learn about the importance of our forests in supporting native biodiversity and the role they play in conserving Singapore’s natural heritage. 

Maximum No. of Participants:15 pax 

Closing Date1 November 2026, Sunday 

Things to BringBring along a  sun protection, water for hydration, rain gear, wear proper walking shoes and wear light appropriate clothing to prevent insect bites.
